agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Financial Statements audited by Purwanto Susanti dan Surja, granting the Board of Directors and Commissioners a full discharge of responsibility.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the 2025 net profit of Rp 45,317,490,000 to be recorded entirely as retained earnings, with no cash dividends distributed for the fiscal year.
Agenda #3: Shareholders authorized the Board of Commissioners to appoint a registered Public Accountant to audit the 2026 financial statements and determine the associated honorarium.
Agenda #4: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 remuneration, honorarium, and facilities for both the Board of Commissioners and Directors.
Agenda #5: This item served as a formal report regarding the accountability of funds used from the Initial Public Offering, and no formal resolution was required.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved changing the company's legal status from a Foreign Investment Company (PMA) to a Domestic Investment Company (PMDN) and authorized the Directors to handle necessary legal documentation.
